data.standardized_narrative: The syndicate's opening gross claims reserves at 1 January 2018 were GBP 1,149.823m. Using the available claims development table (net) the aggregate prior-year movement (excluding the two most recent underwriting years and excluding aggregate '2010 and prior') indicates a net adverse prior-year development of approximately GBP 64.3m (c.5.6% of opening gross reserves). Management cite adverse large loss experience in the International Casualty portfolio (notably Australia and New Zealand) and other adverse claims development as drivers. This estimate is derived from the net claims development triangle because a gross movement note/triangle was not provided, so the figure may be distorted by reinsurance to close or reinsurance recoveries.

data.data_quality_notes: The preferred gross movement in prior years was not explicitly provided. The prior-year development figure has been calculated from the available NET claims development triangle (note 15), not a GROSS triangle or an explicit 'movement in prior year's provision' gross column. Per instructions, this is a fallback (NET-based) estimate and may be distorted by reinsurance to close (RITC) or reinsurance recoveries (notably the large increase in the 2016 column). Exact gross prior-year movement was not found; if a gross movement note exists elsewhere it should be used to replace this NET-derived estimate.
